title: Payment Handler
description: Schema for payment handlers. Uses slim pattern with context-specific required fields for discovery vs response.

id.description: The unique identifier for this handler instance within the payment.handlers. Used by payment instruments to reference which handler produced them.

name.description: The specification name using reverse-DNS format. For example, dev.ucp.delegate_payment.

spec.description: A URI pointing to the technical specification that defines how this handler operates.

config_schema.description: A URI pointing to a JSON Schema used to validate the structure of the config object.

items.description: A URI pointing to a schema definition used to validate the structure of the instrument object.

config.description: A dictionary containing provider-specific configuration details, such as merchant IDs, supported networks, or gateway credentials.

discovery.title: Payment Handler (Discovery)
discovery.description: Full handler declaration for discovery profiles. Includes spec and schema URLs for platform fetching.

response.title: Payment Handler (Response)
response.description: Handler reference in checkout responses. Only id/name/version/config needed; platforms already have schemas from discovery.
